description: 20430-05-02-2 臺中市天然氣事業裝置情形 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府經濟發展局. 由臺中市公用天然氣事業提供天然氣裝置情況統計資料提供了臺中市公用天然氣事業的天然氣裝置情況統計資料，涵蓋了各區域的天然氣裝置數量、裝置類型等相關資訊。 這些資料對於了解臺中市天然氣事業的發展趨勢、需求量等方面具有重要的參考價值。 同時，這些資料也可以用於分析天然氣供應的效率、安全性等方面，進而為相關決策提供依據。. Coverage: 臺中市政府經濟發展局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府經濟發展局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
